sentences.en: A new initiative strives to minimize the number of accidents.
sentences.zh: 一项新的举措旨在减少事故数量。

sentences.en: Is there anything we can do to minimize the risk?
sentences.zh: 我们有没有什么办法可以降低风险？

sentences.en: I want to minimize the chances of another accident.
sentences.zh: 我想尽量避免再次发生事故。

senses.zh: 把…减至最低数量〔程度〕 - 对(某事物)作最低估计;极力贬低(某事物)的价值〔重要性〕
